title: MVN Group Wins First Prize at Genesis Green Living 2026
description: At the Genesis Green Living Challenge 2026 social housing design competition, MVN Group earned First Prize in the Professional category for its "Vertical Hue" proposal.
content:
At the Genesis Green Living Challenge 2026 social housing design competition, MVN Group earned First Prize in the Professional category for its "Vertical Hue" proposal.

Developed for a social housing project in Hue City, "Vertical Hue" reinterprets Hue's traditional garden houses and distinctive community lifestyle within a high-rise residential model. The design integrates natural ventilation, optimizes the microclimate, and meets green building standards to create a sustainable living environment for residents.

This achievement affirms MVN Group's professional expertise, creative thinking, and commitment to advancing green architecture in social housing, helping to create high-quality, people-centered living environments for the community.
